records.description: Formaxus gives site managers to better view tasks their builders have done and it allows for better data driven decisions to keep the project on track to finish on time - 2 students from University College London building Formaxus - trialed by 3 construction companies - built to solve the direct problem of builders not completing their tasks - coordination between different trades, creating clarity on the trades who are the bottleneck for the project's finish

records.name: Spiritual AI
records.tagline: Personalized Solutions built for Individual's Personality
records.description: Spiritual AI maps your cognitive architecture and gives you hyper-personalized tools to change. Vedic astrology, Jungian psychology, and MBTI — combined to help you evolve.

records.name: Epilogue. Write novels, scripts & poetry
records.tagline: The professional book writing app built for serious authors
records.description: Epilogue is the writing environment built for writers who take their craft seriously. Whether you're drafting your first novel, structuring a script, compiling a collection of poems, or sharing a finished book with a large alpha reader group, Epilogue keeps you in flow. No distractions, no server lag, no lock-in.

records.name: AgileBudget
records.tagline: Budget together, stress less.
records.description: AgileBudget is a shared budgeting app for couples, families, roommates, and small groups who want calmer planning, better bill tracking, and less money stress.

records.name: Enhance Lip-Plumping Mask
records.tagline: Elevate Your Lip Care Routine
records.description: Healthy-looking lips start with the right care. COSMEDIX Enhance is a deeply conditioning lip mask that helps replenish moisture, smooth roughness, and give lips a naturally fuller appearance. Whether you use it throughout the day or as an overnight treatment, your lips will thank you.

records.name: calculatorsonline.co.uk
records.tagline: Making complex numbers simple for everyone
records.description: Too many important financial and lifestyle decisions in the UK are made without the right information. Whether it’s understanding your take-home pay, working out stamp duty on a new home, or calculating how many calories you need — the numbers matter. Calculators Online was built on a single idea: that clear, accurate, free tools should be available to everyone — not just those who can afford a financial adviser. We translate complex UK rules into instant, understandable answers

records.name: Paddockdle — Daily F1 Driver Guessing
records.tagline: Guess today's mystery F1 driver — a new puzzle daily.
records.description: Paddockdle is a free daily Formula 1 guessing game. Every day, Paddockdle picks one mystery F1 driver and you have to work out who it is. Type any driver to get instant clues — Classic mode compares team, nationality, age, number, debut, titles and wins with green/amber hints and arrows; Pixel mode reveals a photo that sharpens with each guess; Career mode unlocks one stat at a time.

records.name: Resuvia - Career Guide+
records.tagline: Your resume, optimized with privacy. Your next job, closer.
records.description: 🔒 Privacy-first ATS optimizer — resume bytes never leave your device (AES-256-GCM local). No cloud upload, ever. 🤖 Multi-model AI cascade — Gemini + Mistral + Claude in sequence; best output wins, no vendor lock-in or third party AI. 📋 Real job board matching built-in. 🗺️ Career roadmap + interview Q&A — not just a score, a path forward. 🌍 Region-aware free tier — EU/UK users get privacy-compliant AI routing by default. 🎉 Free to try. Pro available at launch discount.

records.name: Trippin
records.tagline: AI trip planner with real local guides in your chat
records.description: Planning a trip shouldn't take 40 tabs. Trippin puts a real local guide directly in your trip chat — someone who knows what's overrated, what tourists miss, and what's actually worth your time. Tell it where you're going. Get a full day-by-day itinerary: routes, stays, things to do, things to skip. Change your mind anytime — your whole plan updates instantly. No blogs. No ChatGPT threads. No tourist traps. One conversation. A complete trip.

records.name: Percept Pulse 2.0 - Alway Live.
records.tagline: Percept Pulse - Your customers spoke. Did you hear them?
records.description: Most businesses drown in feedback they never read - forms, WhatsApp voices, and cards piling up at the end of a long day. By then, the upset customer is already gone. Percept Pulse fixes that. Customers share feelings in 3 seconds via emoji or voice. AI transcribes, translates & classifies sentiment instantly. See the overall mood at a glance. New in 2.0: 📲 Install as an App 🔔 Instant Alerts for angry & sad feedback ⚡ Works Offline - always accessible Miss nothing. Be everywhere.

records.name: Daily Ink
records.tagline: One question a day, your journal listens back
records.description: Most journaling apps feel overwhelming. Daily Ink is different — one question, one answer, one minute a day. Key features: - A new thoughtful question every day - Write your answer freely, no pressure - AI-powered emotional insights that analyze your state of mind - Streak tracking to build a real habit - Private, secure, and minimal Start for free, upgrade for deeper insights. Built for real consistency, not perfection.

records.name: Pakish: RDP Hosting & On-Demand IT

records.description: Stop fighting with server setups. Pakish delivers high-speed Windows RDPs and managed cloud hosting. It features an integrated 'Task Desk' where experts handle complex deployments, keeping the focus entirely on scaling the business.

Side-by-side comparisons, alternatives and buying guides, in English, French, Spanish and Arabic. No sign-up, completely free.

Users can practice vocabulary, grammar, spelling, sentence building, idioms, proofreading, and verb tenses in one place.

records.name: FDM AI PDF to PSD Converter

records.name: Habit of the Day
records.tagline: Build habits, not streaks
records.description: Habit of the Day is different because it’s consistency‑first, not streak‑first. records.name: CarrySizer

records.description: CarrySizer helps travelers check if their carry-on or personal item fits airline rules before they reach the gate. It includes bag size checking, airline policies, route compliance, fee estimates, and side-by-side airline comparisons. The goal is simple: less confusion before flying.

records.name: RetroMac

records.description: RetroMac wraps your everyday macOS in the look and feel of classic computers: authentic CRT shaders over your whole screen, themed docks and desktops (Mac OS 9, Windows XP/98, BeOS, Amiga…), retro widgets and games, and a virtual webcam that pipes the CRT look into Zoom, Meet or Teams. Open source, free to use with an optional one-time upgrade for extra presets and webcam support.
